amendments.because: Automatic fix creation for flaky tests is not built yet; it is planned in FORGE-FASTPATH-1 after v1.2.45 is measured
amendments.done_when: Close, land and the CI test step rerun a failed job or failed test files only when the failure is a runner loss, cancellation or timeout, never when a test fails its check; a test that passes only on a rerun still opens a fix; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade and forge sync

done_when: Close, land and the CI test step rerun a failed job or failed test files only when the failure is a runner loss, cancellation or timeout, never when a test fails its check; a test that passes only on a rerun is still reported as flaky as today; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade and forge sync
why: Forge reruns failed CI test jobs once (close's 'Started the failed test jobs again once') and reruns failed test files inside a group, even when a test failed its assertion. In Forge's last 150 runs, 0 of 38 job reruns passed and reruns cost 28% of CI time. Owner chose on 21 Nov 2026: rerun only on infrastructure errors.
